descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-94422 AC 5 + AC 7; UAT 3.5 · “If both fail, a clear error shows and the dictation isn't lost”.

Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S11 Never left waiting with nothing: both models fail, a working state shows at once and the failure arrives within the budget

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 When the network drops or an AI provider times out mid-dictation or mid-note-generation, the app retries automatically rather than hanging indefinitely; … (UAT OAT-03 step 1; UAT OAT-03 step 2; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • T3 The full retry sequence stays within about 30 s (TFA-94422 AC 7; UAT 3.5)
  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Local stack with Haiku and Mistral both failing as temporary errors; one Hospital patient and one Nursing Home resident

When Type the dictation, tap Generate Note & Finish, snapshot at once, then again when the screen settles

Then Right after the tap the button shows it is generating (never idle with no feedback); within ~30 s of the tap the explicit failure shows, the dictation is still in the box and Generate Note & Finish is offered again; Post-Round has no blank note

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): cp1 mustContain 'generating'. cp2 / cp3 mustContain the typed dictation, 'Generate Note & Finish' and 'couldn’t be generated' (any explicit message, as both main copies say), plus 'Note not generated' as a known gap (Q3: reported as Fail (known), not as a silent pass), and mustNotContain 'AI-Generated Note'. Backend: no note stored and the chart not finished. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.
